notes.title: Devlog
notes.content:
Hello Players,

We’ve made several updates to timing settings for various game events:

Power Outage Timers
Delay before the first power outage, based on difficulty:

Baby: Increased from 35 seconds to 90 seconds
Normal, Hard, Legendary: Remain the same at 35 seconds
General power outage intervals:

Baby: Increased from 60 seconds to 90 seconds
Normal: Increased from 45 seconds to 60 seconds
Hard: Increased from 35 seconds to 40 seconds
Legendary: Remains at 25 seconds
Monster Spawn Timers
Initial spawn for the window monster:

Baby: Increased from 30 seconds to 50 seconds
Normal: Increased from 30 seconds to 40 seconds
Hard: Increased from 25 seconds to 35 seconds
Legendary: Remains at 25 seconds
Initial spawn for the vent monster:

Baby: Increased from 60 seconds to 120 seconds
Normal: Increased from 45 seconds to 90 seconds
Hard: Increased from 45 seconds to 60 seconds
Legendary: Remains at 45 seconds
Additional Changes
Increased the number of candles available in drawers: from 12 to 24
New drawer animation: Each drawer now has an animation when searched
Added new candle holders: Allows players to place more candles throughout the area
Fixed several bugs, display issues, and improved visual objects such as bedside lamps
Thank you for playing and enjoy the updates!

- The Developer
